# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ZOTHOS — Hermetic Matrix GRUB Theme v3.0 (2028-2030 Cutter)
#  Full-matrix cyberpunk boot: real-time rain, phosphor type, neon progress
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Background: animated matrix rain PNG generated at boot ───────────────
#   The background is a pre-rendered 1920x1080 emerald matrix rain PNG
#   generated by zoth-matrix-rain --boot-bg. Fallback to pure black.
desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-color: "#04060b"

# ── Title bar: phosphorescent emerald with gold accent ────────────────────
title-text: "✦ ZOTHOS — THE ALCHEMICAL INTELLIGENCE & SECURITY OS ✦"
title-color: "#00ff9d"
title-font: "Unifont Regular 20"
title-text-color: "#00ff9d"
title-bg-color: "#000000"

# ── Subtitle / tagline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
subtitle-text: "Herbal Matrix · NullAI Ghostmode · 7 Reality Surfaces"
subtitle-color: "#e2e8f0"
subtitle-font: "Unifont Regular 11"

# ── Terminal / kernel log output ────────────────────────────────────────────
terminal-box: "terminal_box_*.png"
terminal-font: "Fixed 11"
terminal-color: "#00ff9d"
terminal-bg-color: "#050807"

# ── Boot menu — holographic glass pane ────────────────────────────────────
+ boot_menu {
    left = 12%
    width = 76%
    top = 28%
    height = 42%
    item_font = "Unifont Regular 14"
    item_color = "#94a3b8"
    selected_item_color = "#00ff9d"
    item_height = 42
    item_padding = 14
    item_spacing = 8
    scrollbar = false
    # Menu background: frosted glass with emerald border glow
    # (rendered via background PNG; fallback to transparent)
}

# ── Timeout progress bar — emerald neon fill ──────────────────────────────
+ progress_bar {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 12%
    width = 76%
    top = 74%
    height = 16
    show_text = true
    text_color = "#f59e0b"
    font = "Unifont Regular 13"
    text = "✦ Booting ZOTHOS in %d seconds..."
    bar_style = "progress_bar_*.png"
    highlight_style = "progress_highlight_*.png"
}

# ── Fallback / rescue entries ───────────────────────────────────────────────
+ fallback_menu {
    left = 12%
    width = 76%
    top = 74%
    height = 8%
    item_font = "Unifont Regular 10"
    item_color = "#64748b"
    selected_item_color = "#00ff9d"
}

# ── Hidden entries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Recovery mode, memtest86+ — shown only with Shift held

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  HOW TO USE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  1. Place this theme.txt in: /boot/grub/themes/zoth-hermetic/
#  2. Generate background.png: zoth-matrix-rain --boot-bg 1920 1080
#  3. GRUB will auto-detect the theme from /boot/grub/themes/zoth-hermetic/
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
